module purge
module load 2019
module load Python/3.7.5-foss-2019b
module load CUDA/10.1.243
module load cuDNN/7.6.5.32-CUDA-10.1.243
module load NCCL/2.5.6-CUDA-10.1.243
module load Anaconda3/2018.12

# Activate your environment
source venv/bin/activate

# Run your code

TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false python -u main.py --gpus -1 --batch_size 2 --learning_rate 5e-4 --max_epochs 300 \
                                         --optimizer adafactor --dataset WQ --logdir t5_WQ --pre_trained t5

issues: The script requests 4 GPUs and 3 CPUs. The python application is launched with `--gpus -1`, which often tells frameworks like PyTorch Lightning to use all available GPUs. This could lead to a CPU bottleneck if data loading is intensive, or it could be an inefficient request if each GPU process only needs one CPU.
